description.value:
Frequency once per day

Effect You impose some distinct bad luck on everyone around you. Each creature except for animals, gremlins, and kholos in a @Template[type:emanation|distance:10] must attempt a @Check[will|against:class-spell] saving throw against the higher of your class DC or spell DC. If the creature fails, it must roll twice and take the worse result on the next check it attempts within the next minute.
